examples.text: Vou te fazer querer nunca ter nascido.
examples.en: I'll make you wish you had never been born.

examples.text: Ele tinha nascido para ser pintor.
examples.en: He was born to be a painter.

examples.text: O homem tinha vergonha de ter nascido pobre.
examples.en: The man was ashamed of being born poor.
I wish I'd been born Canadian.

examples.text: O homem se envergonhava de ter nascido pobre.
examples.en: The man was ashamed of being born poor.
